answer_1.quote: TreeReview, a dynamic tree of questions framework that structures LLM-based peer review as a hierarchical, question-driven reasoning process to efficiently generate in-depth feedback for lengthy papers.

answer_2.quote: In our preliminary experiments for the full review generation task, we employ two widely-used text similarity metrics, ROUGE (including R-1, R-2, R-L) and BERTScore, to evaluate the quality of generated reviews against human-written reference reviews.

answer_3.quote: Specifically, we implement a score-based evaluation procedure using Gemini-2.5-Pro (version gemini-2.5-pro-exp-0325) to rate system-generated reviews on a 0-10 scale across eight dimensions

answer_4.quote: To complement our automatic evaluation, we conduct a human evaluation with 20 papers randomly sampled from the test set.
answer_4.guideline: Evaluators were instructed to select the superior output based on criteria including thoroughness, constructiveness, and specificity for full reviews, and accuracy, specificity, and helpfulness for feedback comments.
